payload.title: Request Payload Rules
payload.desc: Configure how CPA injects defaults (Default), forces overrides (Override) or removes parameters (Filter) when forwarding requests upstream.
payload.default_desc: Inject default values only when the client doesn't send the parameter.
payload.override_desc: Always override client parameters with the specified values.
payload.filter_desc: Remove the specified JSON path fields from client requests before forwarding.
payload.empty: No rules of this type yet
payload.filter_params: Param paths to remove (one per line)
payload.filter_hint: Supports gjson/sjson path syntax. The specified fields are removed from requests sent upstream.
payload.json_hint: Must be a valid JSON object with JSON paths as keys and the values to inject.
payload.invalid_json: Invalid params: must be a valid JSON object
payload.hidden_fields: This rule has content the form doesn't show (e.g. multiple models, headers or match conditions). It is kept as-is on save; use the YAML editor to change it.

yaml.conflict: The config file was changed elsewhere, nothing was saved. Copy your edits, then click "Discard" to load the latest version

server/host.label: Host
server/host.hint: Bind address. Empty or 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces; 127.0.0.1 is local only

server/commercial-mode.label: Commercial Mode
server/commercial-mode.hint: Disable costly request logging and non-essential middleware to minimize memory usage

server/tls/cert.label: TLS Certificate Path
server/tls/cert.hint: Path to the server SSL/TLS certificate file (.crt or .pem)

server/tls/key.label: TLS Private Key Path
server/tls/key.hint: Path to the server SSL/TLS private key file (.key)

management/allow-remote.label: Allow Remote
management/allow-remote.hint: Allow non-localhost clients to access the Management API. Note: the MANAGEMENT_PASSWORD environment variable allows remote access even when this is false

management/secret-key.label: Secret Key
management/secret-key.hint: Management key in plain text. CPA stores it as a bcrypt hash on save; leave empty to keep it unchanged

management/disable-control-panel.label: Disable Control Panel
management/disable-control-panel.hint: Disable hosting of CPA's built-in control panel assets and frontend routes

management/disable-auto-update-panel.label: Disable Panel Auto-Update
management/disable-auto-update-panel.hint: Stop CPA from periodically checking for and downloading the latest control panel release in the background

management/panel-github-repository.label: Panel GitHub Repository
management/panel-github-repository.hint: GitHub repository or releases API URL the control panel is auto-updated from

routing/strategy.label: Strategy
routing/strategy.hint: Round-robin, weighted round-robin, or fill-first (use up one credential before moving on)

routing/session-affinity.label: Session Affinity
routing/session-affinity.hint: Route a session to the same account to maximize prompt cache hits

routing/session-affinity-subagents.label: Subagent Session Affinity
routing/session-affinity-subagents.hint: Subagent sessions inherit the parent's bound credential, improving multi-agent caching for Claude and Codex

routing/force-model-prefix.label: Force Model Prefix
routing/force-model-prefix.hint: Unprefixed requests only use unprefixed credentials, preventing model name pollution

routing/retry/request-retry.label: Request Retry
routing/retry/request-retry.hint: Additional credential retry rounds after the initial round, 3 by default; 0 admits only round 0

routing/retry/max-retry-credentials.label: Max Retry Credentials
routing/retry/max-retry-credentials.hint: Credentials tried per round; 0 tries all eligible credentials

routing/retry/max-retry-interval.label: Max Retry Interval (seconds)
routing/retry/max-retry-interval.hint: Maximum seconds to wait for a credential cooldown between retry rounds

routing/cooldown/disable-cooling.label: Disable Cooling
routing/cooldown/disable-cooling.hint: Completely turn off blocking and cooldown after credential or model failures

routing/cooldown/save-cooldown-status.label: Save Cooldown Status
routing/cooldown/save-cooldown-status.hint: Persist credential cooldown state as .cds files in the auth directory

routing/cooldown/transient-error-cooldow.label: Transient Error Cooldown (seconds)
routing/cooldown/transient-error-cooldow.hint: Cooldown for transient errors such as 408/500/502/504; 0 means 60 seconds, -1 disables it

requests/proxy-url.label: Proxy URL
requests/proxy-url.hint: Default proxy for all upstream requests, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080 or http://proxy:7890; leave empty to connect directly

requests/passthrough-headers.label: Passthrough Headers
requests/passthrough-headers.hint: Forward filtered upstream response headers to the client as-is

requests/streaming/keepalive-seconds.label: SSE Keepalive (seconds)
requests/streaming/keepalive-seconds.hint: Interval for SSE keepalive comments; 0 disables it

requests/streaming/bootstrap-retries.label: Streaming Bootstrap Retries
requests/streaming/bootstrap-retries.hint: Retries on network or protocol errors before the first byte is sent

requests/nonstream-keepalive-interval.label: Non-Stream Keepalive Interval (seconds)
requests/nonstream-keepalive-interval.hint: Emit a blank line every N seconds for non-streaming responses; 0 disables it

oauth/auth-dir.label: Auth Dir
oauth/auth-dir.hint: Directory for account JSON auth files, supports ~. Default ~/.cli-proxy-api

oauth/auth-auto-refresh-workers.label: Auth Auto-Refresh Workers
oauth/auth-auto-refresh-workers.hint: Concurrency for refreshing OAuth tokens in the background, default 16

oauth/providers/aistudio/ws-auth.label: AI Studio /ws Auth
oauth/providers/aistudio/ws-auth.hint: Require clients to send a valid key on the /v1/ws route

oauth/providers/claude/disable-claude-cl.label: Disable Claude Cloak Mode
oauth/providers/claude/disable-claude-cl.hint: Pass requests through as-is without mimicking the Claude Code client fingerprint and system prompt

oauth/providers/antigravity/antigravity-.label: Antigravity Credits
oauth/providers/antigravity/antigravity-.hint: When free quota is exhausted (429/503), allow retrying with credentials that have paid credits

oauth/providers/antigravity/signature-ca.label: Antigravity Signature Cache
oauth/providers/antigravity/signature-ca.hint: Cache and validate thinking block signatures to greatly improve concurrent throughput and stability

oauth/providers/antigravity/signature-by.label: Antigravity Strict Signature Bypass
oauth/providers/antigravity/signature-by.hint: Bypass strict Protobuf signature validation (experimental) for compatibility with specific calls

oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/s.label: Claude Stabilize Device Profile
oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/s.hint: Pin OS and architecture to baseline values per credential to reduce risk-control triggers

oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/u.label: Claude Default User-Agent
oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/u.hint: Baseline Claude Code CLI User-Agent used when the client doesn't send one

oauth/providers/codex/header-defaults/us.label: Codex Default User-Agent
oauth/providers/codex/header-defaults/us.hint: Official Codex User-Agent used when the client doesn't send one

multimedia/disable-image-generation.label: Image Generation
multimedia/disable-image-generation.hint: Control model image generation: allow, disable globally, allow only the image endpoint, or pass through as-is

multimedia/gpt-image-2-base-model.label: Image Base Model
multimedia/gpt-image-2-base-model.hint: Model used to parse and understand image generation prompts, default gpt-5.4-mini

multimedia/video-result-auth-cache-ttl.label: Video Result Auth Cache TTL
multimedia/video-result-auth-cache-ttl.hint: How long a video ID stays bound to the credential that created it, default 3h

observability/logs/debug.label: Debug
observability/logs/debug.hint: Output more detailed gateway internals and routing logs

observability/logs/logging-to-file.label: Logging to File
observability/logs/logging-to-file.hint: Write application logs to rotating files in the log directory

observability/logs/request-log.label: Request Log
observability/logs/request-log.hint: Log full HTTP request and response bodies; enable temporarily when troubleshooting

observability/logs/error-logs-max-files.label: Max Error Log Files
observability/logs/error-logs-max-files.hint: Number of error-*.log files kept when request logging is off

observability/usage/usage-statistics-ena.label: Usage Statistics
observability/usage/usage-statistics-ena.hint: When enabled, CPA pushes requests into the usage queue for the panel to collect; when disabled, the panel can't track usage

observability/usage/redis-usage-queue-re.label: Usage Queue Retention (seconds)
observability/usage/redis-usage-queue-re.hint: How long usage records stay in the in-memory queue, up to 3600 seconds

observability/pprof/enable.label: Enable pprof
observability/pprof/enable.hint: Enable the built-in Go runtime profiling HTTP server

plugins/enabled.label: Enable Plugins
plugins/enabled.hint: Enable the trusted in-process dynamic binary plugin system

plugins/dir.label: Plugin Dir
plugins/dir.hint: Directory for discovering plugin libraries or binaries, default plugins

server/trusted-proxies.label: Trusted Proxies
server/trusted-proxies.hint: IPs or CIDRs allowed to send forwarded client IP headers, one per line; empty trusts none. Requires restart

server/discovery/enabled.label: LAN Service Discovery
server/discovery/enabled.hint: Advertise the service via mDNS / DNS-SD; Docker needs host networking

oauth/request-scoped-errors.label: OAuth Request-Scoped Errors
oauth/request-scoped-errors.hint: Per-channel upstream error rules (JSON object), e.g. {"codex": [{"status": 429, "match": ["..."], "action": "stop"}]}

oauth/providers/codex/disable-codex-cloa.label: Disable Codex Cloaking
oauth/providers/codex/disable-codex-cloa.hint: Don't force the official Codex User-Agent and Originator headers on HTTP, SSE or WebSocket requests

oauth/providers/codex/model-level-coolin.label: Codex Model-Level Cooling
oauth/providers/codex/model-level-coolin.hint: Scope usage_limit_reached cooldowns to the requested model instead of the whole credential

oauth/providers/codex/stream-bootstrap-b.label: Codex Stream Bootstrap Buffering
oauth/providers/codex/stream-bootstrap-b.hint: Hold handshake and heartbeat frames until the first generated event so in-stream overloads can fail over before headers are sent

oauth/providers/codex/stream-bootstrap-t.label: Codex Stream Bootstrap Timeout
oauth/providers/codex/stream-bootstrap-t.hint: Maximum buffering time, e.g. 20s; 0 means no limit

oauth/providers/codex/response-steering.label: Codex Response Steering (experimental)
oauth/providers/codex/response-steering.hint: Full-duplex Responses WebSocket; one socket stays on one account and model

oauth/providers/codex/optimize-multi-age.label: Codex Multi-Agent v2 Optimization
oauth/providers/codex/optimize-multi-age.hint: Optimize multi-agent v2 requests from Codex Desktop, codex-tui and codex_cli_rs; not applied to API key credentials

oauth/providers/claude/model-level-cooli.label: Claude Model-Level Cooling
oauth/providers/claude/model-level-cooli.hint: Scope quota cooldowns to the requested model instead of the whole credential

oauth/providers/claude/claude-code/disab.label: Uncloaked Claude Model List
oauth/providers/claude/claude-code/disab.hint: Return original model IDs in the Anthropic model list instead of cloaked ones

oauth/providers/xai/inject-x-search.label: xAI Inject x_search
oauth/providers/xai/inject-x-search.hint: Inject the native x_search tool when the request doesn't declare it

oauth/providers/antigravity/connection-p.label: Antigravity Connection Pool
oauth/providers/antigravity/connection-p.hint: Enable upstream HTTP connection pooling; short-lived connections are used by default

oauth/providers/antigravity/connection-p.label: Antigravity Idle Connection Timeout
oauth/providers/antigravity/connection-p.hint: How long idle connections are kept, e.g. 30s; capped at 210 seconds

oauth/providers/antigravity/connection-p.label: Antigravity Max Idle Connections per Host
oauth/providers/antigravity/connection-p.hint: Maximum idle connections kept per credential per host

plugins/store-sources.label: Plugin Store Sources
plugins/store-sources.hint: Extra plugin store registry URLs, one per line; the official registry is always included

server/discovery/service-name.label: Service Name Prefix
server/discovery/service-name.hint: Optional name prefix. Advertised as CPA-<ShortID> or <name>-<ShortID>, for example office-8F3B

server/discovery/subtypes.label: Advertised Subtypes
server/discovery/subtypes.hint: One API protocol subtype per line with a leading underscore, for example _responses. Empty uses CPA defaults: chat, responses, messages, generate-content, interactions

server/discovery/interfaces/include.label: Interface Allow-list
server/discovery/interfaces/include.hint: Advertise on these interfaces only, one pattern per line. Empty auto-detects physical interfaces

server/discovery/interfaces/exclude.label: Interface Exclusions
server/discovery/interfaces/exclude.hint: Additional interface patterns to exclude, one per line

server/discovery/auth-required.label: Advertise Credentials Required
server/discovery/auth-required.hint: Announce that clients must authenticate, enabled by default

server/discovery/advertise-management.label: Advertise Management Availability
server/discovery/advertise-management.hint: Announce that the management API is reachable, disabled by default

management/base-url.label: TUI Management Base URL
management/base-url.hint: Remote management base URL for cliproxyapi --tui. Empty means http://127.0.0.1:<port>; --management-base-url wins

oauth/settings.label: Channel Model Metadata
oauth/settings.hint: Per-channel model metadata overrides (JSON object), for example {"codex":[{"name":"gpt-6-sol","max-context-length":524288}]}. The node is replaced as a whole on save

oauth/providers/codex/orphan-delegation-.label: Orphan Delegation Compatibility
oauth/providers/codex/orphan-delegation-.hint: When X-Openai-Subagent is collab_spawn, convert orphan function_call_output items from create_thread / send_message_to_thread into user messages

oauth/providers/codex/header-defaults/be.label: Codex Beta Features Fallback
oauth/providers/codex/header-defaults/be.hint: beta-features fallback for OAuth Codex WebSocket requests when the client omits it

oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/e.label: Codex Live Media Relay
oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/e.hint: Relay Codex Live WebRTC audio and DataChannel traffic in this process; requires inbound UDP. Configure STUN/TURN servers (ice-servers) in the YAML editor

oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/m.label: Media Session Limit
oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/m.hint: Maximum concurrent media sessions. 0 uses the default of 32

oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/d.label: Reject Private Candidates
oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/d.hint: Reject downstream SDP candidates that target private, loopback, link-local, or unspecified IPs. Keep off for local or trusted networks

oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/p.label: Advertised Public Address
oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/p.hint: Public IPv4/IPv6 address advertised when CPA sits behind 1:1 NAT

oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/u.label: UDP Port Range Start
oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/u.hint: Optional lower bound. Set together with the upper bound, with at least two ports per session

oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/u.label: UDP Port Range End
oauth/providers/codex/live-media-relay/u.hint: Optional upper bound. Set together with the lower bound

oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/o.label: Operating System
oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/o.hint: Baseline OS. Pinned to this value when device profile stabilization is on; empty derives it from the runtime

oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/a.label: Architecture
oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/a.hint: Baseline CPU architecture. Pinned when device profile stabilization is on; empty derives it from the runtime

oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/t.label: Timeout Header
oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/t.hint: Fallback timeout header value when the client omits it, for example 600

oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/t.label: Timezone
oauth/providers/claude/header-defaults/t.hint: IANA timezone fallback for the cloaked currentDate. A credential JSON timezone takes priority

oauth/providers/antigravity/sensitive-wo.label: Antigravity Sensitive Words
oauth/providers/antigravity/sensitive-wo.hint: Words obfuscated with zero-width characters in system instructions, one per line. Matching is case-insensitive; empty entries are removed on save

oauth/providers/devin/sensitive-words.label: Devin System Prompt Sensitive Words
oauth/providers/devin/sensitive-words.hint: Words obfuscated with zero-width characters in Devin system instructions and prompts, one per line. A match removes the whole line, so configure carefully

plugins/store-auth.label: Plugin Store Auth Rules
plugins/store-auth.hint: JSON array matching registry and artifact requests by URL prefix. Put token, username, and password environment variable names here, never plaintext values

quota.no_target: No active OAuth accounts with quota query support.
quota.channels_support: Currently supports Codex, Claude, Devin, Kimi, Meta, xAI, Antigravity.
quota.no_matching: No quota information matches the current filters
quota.refresh_failed_count: Quota query failed for {{count}} auth file(s)
quota.reset_hint: Reset this credential's quota through the plugin quota provider and clear its routing quota cooldown

version.dialog_desc: View panel and core service versions, fetch releases, and explore source repositories.

provider_form.not_json: Upstream did not return JSON (HTTP {{status}}); check that the Base URL points to the API
provider_form.base_url_required_test: Base URL is required to test connectivity
provider_form.headers_format: One header per line, formatted as Name: Value
provider_form.vertex_alias_required: Vertex models need an alias; CPA ignores models without one
